# dokploy_projects (Data Source)

Fetches all projects from Dokploy. Use this data source to discover project IDs for importing existing resources.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "dokploy_projects" "all" {}

# Output all project IDs for import discovery
output "project_ids" {
  value = { for p in data.dokploy_projects.all.projects : p.name => p.id }
}
```
